# PreactHub

> Find Preact libraries that actually work — curated compatibility notes, SSR guidance, and practical examples.

PreactHub is a static directory for discovering, comparing, and evaluating Preact-compatible libraries at https://preacthub.com.

## Key pages

- Home: /
- Browse libraries: /libraries
- Methodology (labels & verification): /methodology
- Submit a library: /submit
- Compare libraries: /compare/{slug-a}-vs-{slug-b}

## Catalog facts (0.1)

- 107 library entries across 11 categories
- Compatibility labels: native, compat, community-tested, experimental, unverified, inactive
- Verification dates are shown only when `lastVerifiedAt` is set in catalog data
